lines.beat: Naude enters the interrogation room. She's been called in by the captain to take over the case. She's fearful but determined.
lines.cue: [Naude steps in coyly. Her expression fearful, concerned but determined.]
lines.line: Lance, the captain's called me in to take ove-
lines.hook: She gets CUT OFF. The em-dash is literal — Lance interrupts before she finishes. She never gets to say 'over.'
lines.emotion: Concerned but professional. She knows this is a powder keg.

lines.beat: Lance told her to fuck off. She steps back, finds her resolve, and steps forward again. She knows he has another weapon.
lines.line: Ok, but give it to me Lance. I know you're not careless enough to not have another one on you.
lines.hook: She's asking for his service pistol. 'I know you're not careless enough' — she knows him. She knows he's armed with a backup. 23 years on the force together.
lines.emotion: Resolve through fear. She's shaking but standing her ground.

lines.beat: Lance hands over the gun without looking. Naude retreats toward the door. One last plea before leaving.
lines.cue: [Lance hands her the gun. She receives it and begins retreating toward the door.]
lines.hook: Two words and she gets cut off again. The ellipsis and the em-dash — she's begging and he won't let her finish.
lines.emotion: Desperate. A final attempt to reach the man she's known for decades. She fails.

lines.beat: Oscar asks Lance 'Did you know her?' The question is fuel to Lance's rage. Before he can act, Naude's voice comes through the door — a lifeline from the outside.
lines.cue: OSCAR: "Did you know her detective?" [Lance nearly breaks. A knock is heard at the door.]
lines.hook: Voice-over through the door. Short and official. LANCE / RECESS / CAPTAIN'S ORDER. She's pulling rank to save both of them.
lines.emotion: Firm, professional. Hiding the panic behind protocol.

lines.beat: Lance is about to physically attack Oscar. Naude screams through the door — she's lost all composure. This isn't protocol anymore, it's fear.
lines.cue: [Lance reaches Oscar, ready to pounce. Hard knocking on the door.]
lines.line: LANCE! LANCE! recess! Fuck Lance! I knew this was a bad idea, Captain, pull him out of there!
lines.hook: LANCE x2 / RECESS / FUCK LANCE / BAD IDEA / CAPTAIN / PULL HIM OUT. She swears for the first time — the composure is gone. She's addressing both Lance and the Captain in the same breath.
lines.emotion: Full panic. Screaming. She can hear what's happening and can't stop it.
